scope: Paper reports 367,388 Lao orthography–IPA sentence pairs; seed lexicon has 6,039 word–IPA entries derived from Kerr (1972), with a two-author 500-entry review (97.2% sample accuracy; reviewers are proficient L2 speakers, not native speakers). Sentence pairs are generated by longest-match trie lookup over OPUS text (NLLB/Paracrawl/OpenSubtitles); held-out evaluation is dictionary-seeded and reports <2% CER under the paper's own setup, not independent sentence transcription or our gold. Candidate secondary lexical reference/diagnostic only; not blind adjudicated IPA gold. The repository owner confirms that the project's MekongPhon rights question was fully resolved in the prior project conversation; record rights as OWNER-CONFIRMED-CLEARED for the authorized project use. The upstream snapshot has no root LICENSE file; this owner confirmation is not an independent legal opinion.
